title: PanelCapabilitiesResponse
description: GET /api/types/:id/panel-capabilities (HEL-365) -- for an owner-scoped DataType, which of the five data-bindable panel kinds (metric/chart/table/collection/timeline) are structurally bindable, each kind's required/optional fieldMapping slots and eligible columns per slot, plus shape signals (columns+types, row count, single-row flag, pipeline-output vs. source-companion).

isPipelineOutput.description: true when the DataType's sourceId is unset (a pipeline output, the only kind a panel may bind to -- V41); false for a source-companion DataType.

eligibleColumns.description: Slot key -> eligible column names (advisory; not a bind-time enforced guarantee -- see PanelBindingSpec Scaladoc).

reason.description: Present only when bindable is false. "not-pipeline-output" for a source-companion DataType (V41); "missing-required-column-type" otherwise.

message.description: Present only when bindable is false. For reason "not-pipeline-output", the exact literal text PanelService.rejectCompanionBinding rejects a bind with.
